market_context: The Nasdaq-100 jumped 6.86% to 26,746.10 (QQQ +7.00% to $651.03) after Nvidia's board reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO; the Nasdaq Composite rose 6.51% to 24,089.56 and the S&P 500 4.73% to 7,237.17, their best days since April 2025, reversing a chunk of Friday's correction.
market_cap_basis: Shares outstanding x 2026-11-23 close. Shares implied from Nasdaq market caps as of the 2026-10-29 close (watchlist market_cap_usd / 2026-10-29 close), so multi-class companies (e.g. GOOGL) reflect all share classes.

stocks.name: NVIDIA Corporation Common Stock
stocks.reason: Nvidia's board unanimously reinstated Jensen Huang as president, CEO and a director, effective immediately, after receiving input from senior U.S. government officials that his return posed no national security risk. Melius Research, Bernstein, StoneX and Oppenheimer all upgraded the shares, and Citigroup raised its price target to $240 from $225.
